question: Should this PR's one-logical-send-to-multiple-Discord-post behavior be accepted with the latest reply and receipt coverage, or should maintainers require more proof before merge?
rationale: Green ordinary checks do not fully decide Discord message-delivery semantics because the diff changes how replies, receipts, progress, and overflow batches map onto physical Discord messages.

options.title: Accept Current Coverage
options.body: Proceed with the current Discord-owned batching implementation if maintainer review agrees the reply and receipt tests cover the risky fan-out cases.

options.title: Request More Proof
options.body: Ask for an additional Discord proof run or targeted test if maintainers want stronger evidence for overflow replies, receipts, or component interactions before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Coverage
recommendation.body: Proceed with the current Discord-owned batching implementation if maintainer review agrees the reply and receipt tests cover the risky fan-out cases.
